title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: An American Hymn
description: Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs An American Hymn, a concert of sacred works by American composers. The program features Jessie Montgomery's Starburst, Bernstein's Chichester Psalms with the Combined University Choirs, and Copland's Appalachian Spring, built around the Shaker hymn Simple Gifts. Tickets are sold only through HammonsHall.com and MissouriStateTix.com, the official ticketing services.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
